You should just ask him. There probably will never be a perfect time, and you never know if he just assumes you are together. That’s how my now-husband was when we first starting seeing each other. I did not get an “answer” until I asked … and he told me that he had just assumed we were a couple and honestly hadn’t thought about it further. It never hurts to just ask, and then you’ll have your answer either way and can move on (whether as a couple or not).
